The TGS module enhances temporal resolution by applying gated convolutions across multiple scales, enabling capture of long-range dependencies. This is complemented by TFD, which aligns student and teacher feature maps using a time-varying loss coefficient λ(t). The method leverages unlabeled data through TMA, which masks temporal segments to encourage robust feature extraction. These primitives form a dual framework: one for structured temporal modeling and another for semi-supervised learning. Failure modes include misalignment in teacher-student dynamics, label leakage due to random sampling, and insufficient variance in augmented views.
